data_provenance: Δ-scores from live Liganx baseline (spike #5, commit 799966b). ESM2 + accessibility layers are placeholders pending spike #6/#7. Calibrated probability column will be back-filled once the joint model lands.

predicted_resistance.rationale: P-loop residue, single-nt-accessible (GAG→AAG), Δ +3.5 kcal/mol — strongest signal in this drug's pocket scan. Clinically documented (von Bubnoff 2002, PMID 12200358).
P-loop residue, single-nt-accessible (TAC→CAC), Δ +2.7 — well above noise. Imatinib resistance documented (Branford 2003).
Gatekeeper residue — the textbook Imatinib resistance event. Single-nt-accessible (ACT→ATT). Δ +2.1 kcal/mol matches the >400× cellular IC50 shift documented in Gorre 2001.

On KIT (Imatinib's second indication, GIST/mastocytosis). Activation-loop mutation that pushes the kinase into the active state Imatinib cannot bind. Δ +1.9 kcal/mol; clinical IC50 shift >100× (Heinrich 2003).

ledger_note: Atlas v1 is back-filled from published clinical resistance events. v2 onward will surface NOVEL predictions — mutations the model flags that have NOT yet appeared in clinical literature — with timestamps. Each subsequent clinical confirmation will compound the credibility ledger.
